card.name: Word-start "Ach" in names and terms
card.fires_on: The piece "Ach" or "ach" at the start of a word, after which the word continues. It appears in names like Achim and Achenbach and in terms like acholic, achalasia and achlorhydria.

modes.label: Medical terms starting ach
modes.description: Lowercase "ach" opens a medical term such as achalasia, acholic or achlorhydria in a list of conditions.
